summary: Independent chronology approval of the exact candidate-2 job after checking all 16 owned Chinese units, all 19 owned temporal/hint items, and all four owned people. Units s0001-s0008 are title, dynasty/author attribution and textual incorporation; s0009-s0011 identify the Tang commentator; s0012-s0015 describe the work and its authors; s0016 gives the retrospective combined-printing statement. Book-part counts are not personal ages, and none of these units supplies an omitted explicit personal birth, death or age. Every supplementary local quotation was checked against the actual corpus unit and full-unit SHA-256; external textual witnesses were independently read and all twelve cited calendar queries independently rerun. AD 432-446 and AD 266-275 remain event-uncertainty windows, not continuous activity. The AD 1022 printing order is posthumous reception with only a lower publication bound, and Zhenzong's mistaken local reign attribution is explicitly distinguished from his verified reign. Li Xian's conflicting ages 32/34 and the separately witnessed birth/death chronology remain source-qualified rather than harmonized. Traditional ages, lunar/Western-year differences, the Yuanjia textual emendation, and Sima Biao's one-sided death bound are preserved. No unsupported conversion or chronology finding remains within this bounded audit.

itemChecks.event: Fan Ye's own composition of the annals and biographies, after demotion and before execution.
itemChecks.reason: The local author and Liu Song affiliation are explicit in s0002-s0003 and s0015, but do not themselves supply numbered years. Independently checked Song shu 069 s0112-s0116 places his demotion and ensuing composition after Yuanjia 9 winter. The checked edition's textual note explicitly emends transmitted 元年 to 九年, supported by the preceding Yuanjia 7 narrative; the candidate preserves that variant and identifies its corrected reading. The calendar query for Liu Song Wendi, Yuanjia 9, month 10 day 1 returns 432-11-09 Julian, establishing the earliest Western year of that winter, not an exact composition date. Song shu 005 s0428/s0438 dates his execution to Yuanjia 22 month 12 yiwei, independently converted to 446-01-23 Julian. Thus AD 432-446 is a source-qualified outer authoring window, not continuous activity, a lifespan, or a claimed completion day.
